What Is NDT Level III Consulting?

NDT Level III consulting represents the pinnacle of non-destructive testing expertise. Level III professionals are certified to develop procedures, certify personnel, audit inspection programs, and provide technical leadership across all NDT methods including UT, RT, MT, PT, ET, PAUT, TOFD, and advanced techniques.

Industries worldwide—oil & gas, nuclear, aerospace, maritime, power generation, and manufacturing—rely on Level III consultants to ensure compliance with international standards such as ASNT SNT-TC-1A, ISO 9712, NAS-410, API, ASME, and sector-specific codes.

Atlantis NDT provides professional Level III consulting services globally: Atlantis NDT Consulting Services

Core Level III Responsibilities

1. Procedure Development & Approval

Level III professionals develop, review, and approve all NDT procedures ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards (ASME, API, AWS, ISO, EN).

2. Personnel Certification

Certify Level I and Level II technicians through written, practical, and visual examinations. Maintain certification records and ensure recertification compliance.

3. Technical Oversight

Provide technical authority for NDT operations, interpret results, resolve technical disputes, and make final acceptance decisions.

4. Training Program Development

Design and deliver training programs for Level I and II personnel, ensuring competency in all required methods and applications.

5. Code Interpretation

Interpret and apply industry codes, standards, and specifications to specific inspection scenarios and client requirements.

6. Quality Assurance

Establish and maintain quality systems, conduct audits, and ensure continuous improvement of NDT programs.

Global Certification Standards

North America

ASNT SNT-TC-1A: Employer-based certification widely used in USA and Canada. Requires minimum experience, training, and examination.

International

ISO 9712: International personnel certification standard used globally. Requires third-party certification body involvement.

Europe

EN ISO 9712: European implementation of ISO 9712 with additional requirements for specific industries.

Aerospace

NAS-410: Aerospace-specific standard for NDT personnel qualification. Stricter requirements than SNT-TC-1A.

Nuclear

ASME Section V & XI: Nuclear industry requirements for NDT personnel and procedures.

Maritime

IACS Requirements: International Association of Classification Societies standards for marine applications.

Industry-Specific Applications

Oil & Gas

Level III consultants support refineries, pipelines, offshore platforms with API 510, 570, 653 compliance, RBI program development, and TAR planning.

Aerospace

NAS-410 certified Level III professionals provide composite inspection, turbine component evaluation, and structural integrity assessment.

Nuclear Power

ASME Section XI expertise for reactor vessel inspection, safety-related component evaluation, and regulatory compliance.

Manufacturing

Weld procedure qualification, quality control program development, and client audit preparation for fabrication shops.

Maritime

Hull integrity, weld inspection, and corrosion monitoring for ships, offshore structures, and subsea equipment.

Power Generation

Boiler, turbine, and pressure vessel inspection programs for conventional and renewable energy facilities.

Regional Requirements & Considerations

Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman)

Key Requirements:

  • ARAMCO, ADNOC, QP specifications compliance
  • Local regulatory approvals and licensing
  • Arabic language documentation (some cases)
  • Cultural awareness and business practices
  • Refinery and petrochemical focus

India

Key Requirements:

  • OISD compliance for oil & gas facilities
  • Export quality requirements for fabrication
  • Cost-effective solutions and local partnerships
  • Railway and infrastructure standards
  • Manufacturing quality control systems

United States

Key Requirements:

  • ASNT SNT-TC-1A or NAS-410 certification
  • ASME Section V and Section XI for nuclear
  • API standards for oil & gas
  • DOT regulations for pipeline integrity
  • State-specific licensing requirements

Europe

Key Requirements:

  • EN ISO 9712 certification mandatory
  • Pressure Equipment Directive (PED) compliance
  • National regulations (UK, Germany, France)
  • Offshore wind and nuclear standards
  • Multi-language capabilities beneficial
